runs.t: Clark Pacific's prefabricated AccelDeck™ complements the total prefabricated structural system — further accelerating the construction schedule, streamlining chiller installation, and improving long-term accessibility.
Elevated support for chillers, tanks, and cooling equipment above the building — preserving grade-level circulation and site perimeter.
Clear spans support heavy equipment and flexible layouts — customizable beam profile and spacing accommodates most chiller models.
Structural embeds allow direct mechanical and electrical connections — plant-installed Unistrut supports chilled-water piping and related equipment.
Day 1 & Day 2 zones enable infrastructure expansion without redesign — future capacity planned from the start.
Plant-installed Unistrut and embeds enable piping, cable trays, and AHUs to be hung directly from the structure without field drilling.
Built-in raceways and supports streamline field installation of MEP and electrical systems.

runs.t: AccelDeck™ moves chillers and primary distribution above the data center — keeping grade-level circulation, walls, and site perimeter clean. The prefabricated platform organizes routing, access, embeds, and equipment support into one repeatable system for faster, more predictable installation.

runs.t: Traditional at-grade chiller yards consume valuable site area and crowd the perimeter with exposed equipment, piping, headers, and field-built steel — increasing trade coordination, constraining access, and reducing flexibility for generators, electrical yards, and future expansion.

Beam profile and spacing accommodates most chiller models — giving owners flexibility to procure different chillers late in the manufacturing phase, even allowing future replacements without modifying the underlying support.
Standard configuration supports chiller, tanks, and equipment with weights up to 40,000 lbs. Design can be customized to accommodate more challenging configurations.
Fully compatible with Clark Pacific's AccelCore™ structural system, ensuring durability, longevity, and seamless integration with the overall project.

runs.t: Incorporating AccelDeck™ into a prefabricated precast data center can reduce project timelines by months — an additional 4–8 weeks of schedule compression.

AccelDeck™ is Clark Pacific's prefabricated mechanical platform solution for data centers. It supports and coordinates rooftop mechanical equipment, MEP platform zones, access areas, embeds, penetrations, grating, support points, and equipment interfaces as part of a more complete prefabricated building strategy.
